name: Wormhole n150 tt-metal: Mamba-2.8B batch-32 tok/s per user
unit: tok/s per user at batch 32; 451.2 tok/s aggregate
methodology: VENDOR demo in tenstorrent/tt-metal models/README.md (matrix last updated 2025-12-08). Mamba 2.8B, single n150 (Wormhole), batch 32, TT-Metalium v0.59.0-rc38. ttft 35 ms. t/s/u 14.1 is 1/inter-token-latency of the first generated token (per user); aggregate t/s is 451.2 = 14.1 * 32 concurrent requests, NOT a per-request rate. Mamba is the one model in the table not pinned to input sequence length 128. Per-user figure recorded; aggregate noted in unit.
notes: Vendor demo numbers, not a vLLM serving trace. The README states t/s = t/s/u * batch and that vLLM-server performance may differ. LLM rows use input sequence length 128 except Mamba, which accepts any length. Starred Blackhole figures carry the vendor's own caveat that the software is still under active optimization.
